$comment: Civil penalties for late filing/payment + EOPT taxpayer classification. Draft pending research reconciliation.

legalBasis: RA 11976 (EOPT) Sec 45 — reduced 10% surcharge for micro & small taxpayers
surcharge.notes: EOPT also removed the 25% surcharge for filing at the wrong venue.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 249, as amended by RA 10963 (double the BSP legal rate of 6%)
RA 11976 (EOPT) — 50% of the rate for micro & small taxpayers
interest.notes: 12% per annum confirmed current as of Aug 2026 (in force since TRAIN, 2018). Deficiency and delinquency interest never run simultaneously.

legalBasis: RMO 7-2015 Annex A (failure to file/pay) — confirmed still the operative schedule as of Aug 2026
RA 11976 (EOPT) — 50% reduction for micro & small taxpayers
compromiseTiers.notes: Compromise penalties are settlements in lieu of criminal prosecution and are consensual/negotiable; the schedule is the BIR's standard ask. RMO 7-2015 remains current, but the exact tier amounts here could not be checked against the Annex A text itself — have a CPA confirm before quoting a client.

classification.notes: Classification is by gross sales; micro & small taxpayers get the reduced surcharge/interest, a ₱500 cap on Sec 250 information-return penalties, and 50% off compromise penalties.
